brief:
Niveen Al-Gharabli has established a makeshift book stall amid the destruction of Gaza's schools and universities, Al Jazeera English reported. The effort aims to preserve access to reading material as educational infrastructure across the territory continues to be damaged.

Al-Gharabli has rescued books from the rubble of destroyed buildings to stock her stall. The initiative represents an attempt to maintain educational continuity for residents in a context of widespread destruction affecting formal schooling institutions.
dek: Amid the destruction of Gaza’s schools and universities, Niveen Al-Gharabli has built a makeshift book stall.
title: Gaza woman salvages books from rubble to sustain education
